title: The Innocent Courier: Covert Exfiltration Through Legitimate LLM Web Fetching
abstract: arXiv:2610.01768v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: With the increasing capabilities of Large-Language-Models (LLMs) and LLM-based agents, users are increasingly using them to solve everyday problems, such as answering e-mails or providing programming support. Existing work has extensively investigated security and privacy risks, such as prompt injections and the disclosure of sensitive data to chatbot providers. While various solutions were developed to address these risks, including input structuring to prevent prompt injections or deploying local LLMs to avoid sharing confidential data with chatbot operators, LLMs also pose the risk of leaking confidential data to third parties.   In this paper, we demonstrate with LLMLeak a novel attack vector where malicious software that runs locally but cannot communicate directly with the internet abuses LLMs to establish a covert channel. translated_title: 无辜的信使：通过合法的大语言模型网页抓取进行隐蔽数据外泄
translated_abstract: 随着大语言模型（LLM）及基于LLM的智能体能力的不断提升，用户越来越多地使用它们来解决日常问题，例如回复电子邮件或提供编程支持。现有研究已广泛探讨了安全与隐私风险，例如提示注入攻击以及向聊天机器人提供商泄露敏感数据。尽管已有多种解决方案来应对这些风险，包括通过结构化输入防止提示注入，或部署本地LLM以避免与聊天机器人运营商共享机密数据，但LLM还存在将机密数据泄露给第三方的风险。在本文中，我们通过LLMLeak展示了一种新型攻击向量：在本地运行但无法直接访问互联网的恶意软件，可以利用LLM建立隐蔽信道。虽然指示LLM通过生成代码直接发送数据的输入很容易被检测到，网络……
tldr: 本文提出LLMLeak攻击，展示了一种新型攻击向量：无法直接联网的本地恶意软件可以利用LLM合法的网页抓取功能建立隐蔽信道，从而实现机密数据的外泄。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces LLMLeak, a novel attack vector in which locally-running malware without direct internet access abuses legitimate LLM web fetching capabilities to establish a covert channel for exfiltrating confidential data.
